description: Instructional figure for lesson alg8-c2-s2-n10: closed upper-left quadrant, including its two bounding axis rays and origin. Source cell dimensions, integer phase, source labels and boundary inclusion are retained.

authoritativeText.text:
我们来讨论二元不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}y&\geqslant x,\\x^2+y^2&\leqslant9.\end{aligned}\right.$
这个不等式组的解集合是其中各不等式的解集合的交集。
我们来看看，以所讨论的不等式组的解为坐标的平面上点的集合是什么。

坐标满足不等式$y\geqslant x$的点的集合，是直线$y=x$上的点的集合与这条直线上方的开半平面上的点的集合的并集（图22中用水平细线表示）。
坐标满足不等式$x^2+y^2\leqslant9$的点的集合，是圆心在坐标原点、半径为3的圆形区域，包含内部和边界（图22中用铅直细线表示）。

一个点的坐标满足这个不等式组，当且仅当这个点属于这两个点集的交集。
图22中，两种细线重叠的区域就是这两个点集的交集。
这就是说，所讨论的不等式组给出一个包含内部和边界的半圆形区域。

例1：考察不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}x&\leqslant0,\\y&\geqslant0\end{aligned}\right.$
它给出第二象限及其在坐标轴上的边界，包含坐标原点（图23）。

例2：考察不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}y&\geqslant2x-3,\\y&\leqslant2x+2\end{aligned}\right.$
它给出以直线$y=2x-3$和$y=2x+2$为边界的带形区域，包含两条边界直线（图24）。

inventory.description: Exactly 12 columns by 12 rows, but NOT origin-centered vertically: six cells left/right, eight above and four below. Source bounds [-6,8,6,-4], steps [1,1], offsets [0,0]; origin left/right/above/below [6,6,8,4].

Shared axes, positive-end arrowheads, x/y/0 labels and two first-positive unit labels; y-unit label is to the LEFT of the y axis. Original labels and sides: 0: Immediately southwest of the axes intersection, below x axis and left of y axis. x: Near positive x end, below the axis, to the right of the arrowhead. y: Near positive y end, to the left of the vertical axis. 1: Below x axis at the first coarse grid line right of the origin, x=1. 1: Left of y axis at the first coarse grid line above the origin, y=1; inside the hatched quadrant near its right edge.

Only the upper-left quadrant is diagonally hatched. Its x/y axis boundary rays are included and solid. Original shading: Parallel oblique strokes rising from southwest to northeast (/), neither horizontal nor vertical; Upper-left quadrant only: x<=0 and y>=0 within frame. The non-positive x ray, non-negative y ray, and origin are included. No deliberate dashed boundary.
